verdict: Google spend tripled this week; leads did not follow, cost per lead elevated.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 7 tracked paid leads at a cost of $260.27 per lead on $1,821.89 in total ad spend — a cost per lead that climbed alongside a 256% week-over-week surge in Google spend that produced zero additional leads in the final three days of the period. Separately, 48 opportunities were marked won in your CRM this period, well above the 7 paid leads, which tells us a meaningful share of your business is coming in through channels not yet fully connected to ad tracking. Google ad spend is being reviewed and reined in to restore efficiency before heating-season campaigns go live October 1. Six project milestones are currently overdue — including the intake owner role and the booking automation — and those are the priority for resolution this coming week, as they are gating the scale-up that is planned for late October.

highlights.phrase: paid leads received in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period, up in line with the Google spend spike
opportunities won in your CRM this period, most arriving outside tracked ad channels

watch_item.issue: Google ad spend jumped 256% week-over-week with no corresponding increase in leads, keeping cost per lead elevated heading into heating season.
watch_item.fix: Google campaign pacing is being pulled back and restructured this week so spend is in control before the October 1 heating campaign launch.
